task: Prepare custom and built-in LangGraph subagent executors concurrently with bounded, configurable concurrency while preserving ordering, identity, version pinning, failure semantics and shared-state safety, plus timing instrumentation and tests (EPMCDME-15952).

key_reasoning.reason: Fan-out touches assistant_engine_builder.create_subagent_executors, assistant_factory.create_assistant_executors, the shared AssistantService.build_agent pipeline (context/workspace/file handling), a new config field and timing instrumentation.

No precedent for fanning out agent builds (closest: datasource ThreadPoolExecutor, which does not cover contextvar propagation, shared-state or ordering safety). ContextVars (litellm_context, logging, OTel, DB session) do not cross threads; builtin children are shallow copies sharing mutable parent state; skill workspace seeding may race; thread_generator thread-safety is unverified. ACs enumerate edge/failure/out-of-order cases and no existing concurrency test template covers them, so Technical Risk is bumped from L to XL. Borderline 20/21 total leans higher because Technical Risk is XL.
About 3-4 source files (engine builder, factory, config, possibly assistant_service/utils) plus 2-4 test files across service, tools, configs and tests directories.
